videos.caption: Miso happy to be visiting Austin, TX & eating all the good food. O-fish-ally a fan of this city. We rolled up to momosushimn at hmartofficial. We shared this combo poke that had a bed of sushi rice, seaweed salad, cucumber, avocado, corn, salmon mixed with masago, & spicy sauce with a side of miso soup. (Mimi Sushi at HMart, Austin TX)

Soup-er happy we stopped at ramentatsu_ya! I’m porkin’ obsessed with ramen, & they came highly recommended. I got the sho-yu (tonkatsu) which has pork bone broth, soy sauce blend, Chashu pork, ajitama egg, menma (bamboo), scallion, nori, & pepper. I also got a corn bomb (honey, butter, & corn ) & the chili bomb. (Ramen Tatsuya, Austin TX)

In queso you’re wondering…the tacos from taqueromuchoaustin are fire. They must be the taco-f the town. I got the poblano taco on a flour tortilla; it had grilled poblano pepper coated in whipped egg & lightly fried. It’s topped with cabbage, pico de gallo, & queso sauce. It also came with a side of beans & rice. (Taquero Mucho, Austin TX)
taqueromuchoaustin, Austin TX Elote Poblano Taco

roundups.title: Bar Harbor and Acadia, Maine
roundups.excerpt: Mayo weekend be blessed with a lobster roll!

videos.caption: Mayo weekend be blessed with a lobster roll! Having a great time in Mount Desert Island Main exploring Acadia National Park. Also super happy to be fueling with food like this. First stop was mdilobster (/10)

After a 10 mile bike ride around Acadia…this burger felt like the paddy on the back that we needed. stewmansdowntown has this Stewman’s Burger that comes with flame grilled thick & juicy burger on a fresh baked roll, lettuce, tomato, onion, & cheese of choice (I got Swiss). The burger was legitimately juicy & delicious. We also loved the view of the water while eating (Stewman’s Lobster Pound, Bar Harbor ME)

I finally have time to rave about my vacation eats at Bar Harbor, Maine. This here is the maple glazed Scottish salmon. It comes with duck fat potatoes, summer corn succotash, braised greens, & Pinot Grigio butter. It was perfectly cooked with a great balance of flavor (Paddy’s Restaurant, Bar Harbor ME)

It’s hard to be crabby if you’re eating meals like this. Mayo palettes be blessed with this Jonah Crab & Lobster cake! It comes with roasted pepper salad & siracha-lemon aioli. This was one of the best crab cakes we’ve ever had, and you can see legit chunks of lobster. (Stewman’s Lobster Pound, Bar Harbor ME)

Taco bout a treat! I miss our visit to Bar Harbour, Maine. Visiting langostabarharbor was one of the best decisions. This was the camote taco which had sweet potato with portobello, slaw, & creamy cilantro lime sauce. Now I have myself drooling all over again!

roundups.title: New York City eats
roundups.excerpt: Got a pizza the city in my mouth from joespizzanyc!

videos.caption: Sweet dreams from this sweet baby. I will never forget the spoonfuls of this goodness from my NYC trip. Matcha green tea ice cream for life.
Are you china eat some lobster with me? We had the deal of the day consisting of 2 lobsters sauteed with ginger and garlic for only $20! Eat like a king, but with a laymen budget. (Ming Kee Kitchen)

If he don't bring you out to eat in NYC...let that mango. Everytime I come to NYC Chinatown, I HAVE to stop at Mango Mango for their fresh mango desserts. I always get the snow white juice with mango and black rice. The snow white juice is sweetened coconut milk that tastes like heavenly juices. The mango is always sweet and delicious. The black rice is. If you go here...you won't regret it.

Mayo(naise) have a great day filled with good eats. Check out this dish of jumbo mayo shrimp with honey glazed walnuts and broccoli. The perfect combination right here. (Ming Kee Kitchen, NYC Chinatown)

Happy humpday! Power through the rest of the week with some serious carbs. Like this beef with black bean sauce on noodles. One of the saucy-est things I've ever laid eyes on. Stood in line at Wo Hop for an hour because we heard great things. Although the wait is typically long, their prices are very decent! (Wo Hop City, NYC)

Saturday is for seafood! I have a hard heart, but I have a softshell heart for this dish. I love eating softshell crab cause I don't have to de-shell it to eat...lazy eater at it's finest. (Ming Kee Kitchen, NYC)
Holy lawd...it is ducking cold out today. Maybe this roasted duck noodle will help! (Ming Kee Kitchen, NYC)
If you're ever down in the dumps...these will make you feel better, promise. Look how beautiful this bad boy looks, glistening in soy sauce ready to be eaten. (Wo Hop, NYC)

One of the best ramen dishes broth to you by ichiranny! The experience here is so cool! Everyone gets their own person booth, you check mark what you want to order, & you press a button to call over waitstaff whenever you need them. You also never have to look them in the face if you hate people but love good ramen. I added seaweed, mushrooms, & eggs in my tonkatsu ramen, yum!

Got a pizza the city in my mouth from joespizzanyc! They came highly recommended to us…& did not disappoint. I got the pizza slice with red onions, mushrooms, & pepperoni. There’s a great ratio between cheese & sauce. I absolutely love the crispiness of the bottom of the pizza as well as how giant the slice was. This will be a necessity for every trip to NYC now (Joe’s Pizza, New York, NY)

Holy guacamole, I need to taco bout these porkin’ goodass quesadillas from lostacos1. They’re so good, they turned my tastebuds on-ion. I got the “adobada” quesadilla which is marinated pork. It comes with onions, salsa, guacamole, & cilantro. If you order a quesadilla, it comes with cheese, & it is open faced. These were so well balanced & flavorful…I wish I ordered more than one (Los Tacos No. 1, New York, NY)

I hope everyone has an eggcellent Tuesday. I would kale to eat this eggtremely delicious Nova Benny from friedmansnyc again. It surpassed my expectations by a latke. The Nova Benny comes with a jumbo potato latke, smoked salmon, poached eggs, kale, & hollandaise sauce. The bartender also gave me spicy mayo…& it was absolute perfection. You should’ve seen the yolk run (Friedman’s Hell’s Kitchen, NY New York)

O-ma-god-se…this is the best dining experience I’ve ever had! This is a legit omakase experience…omakase is a Japanese dining experience where guests leave themselves in the hands of the chefs. You sit right in front of the chef(s) while they prepare each roll by hand & tell you all about the sushi/ingredients. Shoutout to our main chef Nicky, who was amazing! (Sushi by M, NYC)

Whatsoup my foodie friends! Get yourself through the mid-week dump(ling)s with some souper yummy soup dumplings from shanghai21mottst. This was my first time having legit soup dumplings & I love it! These dumplings are uniquely made with soup inside & there’s a certain way you eat it in order to get the soup, meat, & dumpling in one bite. (Shanghai 21, NYC)
My reaction to this was…Oh! Taisho good. This is the Katsu Curry from ohtaishonyc. It has taisho beef curry with crispy pork cutlets & white rice. It was such a heart-warming meal

roundups.title: Oahu, Hawaii
roundups.excerpt: I’m going coconuts thinking about these mangos tossed in a little tajin & chamoy.

videos.caption: I’m going coconuts thinking about these mangos tossed in a little tajin & chamoy. It was juicy, sweet, & perfectly balanced. We were on vacation in Oahu. We went to the alohastadswapmeet, & stumbled on hawaii_vanilla_plantation. She had the freshest fruit stand! I’m definitely stopping by again on my next Hawaiian visit (Hawaiian Vanilla Plantation, Oahu HI)

Dough you want a treat? I think you do! These are malasadas are Portuguese fried dough, or a fried type of donut. We had some from the famous leonardsbakeryhawaii! We got half a dozen to try a bunch of flavors. I just say the filling is VERY light, not too strong or sweet. The dough is the star of the show though…super light, airy, & crispy! Check out this guava one busted open. (Leonard’s Bakery, Honolulu HI)
Oh snap(per)…this cajun red snapper hit the spot. I love how you pick a fish, flavor, & style of cooking. The cole slaw & rice went very well together (Paia Fish Market, Honolulu HI)

roundups.title: Aruba
roundups.excerpt: This dish was g(lamb)orous.

videos.caption: This dish was g(lamb)orous. I got the lamb cooked medium rare from Krystal’s Restaurant in the Riu Palace All-Inclusive and it was absolutely delicious. It was tender & flavorful, best lamb I’ve ever had (Krystal’s riuhotels [Aruba])

I am not lime-ing when I say this was one of the best things we ate in Aruba. zeerovers serves fresh caught seafood daily! We got the shrimp, fish of the day, plaintains, & their tartar sauce. The dry rub seasoning was perfection. The views were perfection! The seafood was fresh & delicious. The plaintains were bomb & the tartar sauce was homemade gold. (Zeerover’s, Aruba)

roundups.title: New Orleans girls’ trip
roundups.excerpt: I am an absolute shucker for some oysters!

videos.caption: I am an absolute shucker for some oysters! These were the best oysters we had in New Orleans during our girls’ trip! These babies were from mambos_nola. They’re the “mambos famous oysters” that are freshly shucked, chargrilled over an open flame, smothered with zesty garlic & herb cajun sauce & finished with a romano/parmesan blend. If anything brings me back to NOLA…it’ll be the oysters (Mambo’s, NOLA)

roundups.title: Mystic, Connecticut
roundups.excerpt: Had a claw-some lunch at red36ct last weekend.

videos.caption: You need to risott-GO to red36ct for some delicious eats. I got the seared scallops that came with truffle mushroom rissoto & arugula. Not only was the food delicious but the view was beautiful...looking out to the water (Red35, Mystic CT)

Had a claw-some lunch at red36ct last weekend. Lettuce rejoice over this delicious lobster cobb salad. It comes with buttery hot lobster, bib lettuce, avocado, tomatoes, corn, hard boiled egg, bacon, red onion, blue cheese & balsamic dressing. It was super refreshing, delicious & light on the stomach

If you don’t like pizza…I’d need to slice you outta my circle! This is the chipotle chicken pizza from pizzettamystic. It has chipotle pesto, grilled chicken, sweet corn, sweet onion, mozzarella & Asiago cheese

We had a claw-some day in Mystic, CT. We stopped at spoyster for a late lunch. I got the special of the day, a lobster risotto. I love corn, mushrooms, lobster & risotto…so it was kind of a no-brainer. The risotto could have been softer & more flavorful. I also wish the lobster was a little more moist. But we had a great time & a wonderful view (S&P Oyster)
I’m in berry grave need of this frosé from red36ct cause it is hot today! It’s basically a rosé slushee with frozen fruit…it was perfection (Red 35, Mystic CT)

roundups.title: Provincetown
roundups.excerpt: P-town absolutely exceeded expectations this past weekend!

videos.caption: P-town absolutely exceeded expectations this past weekend! We (lobster) rolled into the sweetest little last minute getaway...nobody (slaw) it coming. Our first stop was Patio American Grill & Cocktail Bar right in the center of town & only a 5 minute walk away from our Inn. The atmosphere & staff were amazing, highly recommend. (Patio American Cocktail Bar & Grill)
Eat whatever your heart desires…the world is your oyster. Had the most delicious oysters while visiting the Cape in Provincetown. (Patio American Grill, Provincetown MA)

roundups.title: Tina’s Instagram eats, 2021
roundups.excerpt: Tina’s 2021 Instagram posts from around Massachusetts and New England. Menus and businesses may have changed since.

videos.caption: Hopefully this New Year will be a piece of pan-cake compared to the last...or I'm going to go bananas. Had one of the best banana chocolate chip pancakes at westoncentre! It didn't even need syrup...& I'm a saucy girl...which says alot (West on Centre, West Roxbury)

You'd be making a huge mis-steak if you didn't stop at sofia_italian_steakhouse for a delicious meal. But(ter) do not fear, I'm hear to spread the good food news. My boyfriend loves getting this grilled 8 oz buckhead beef center cut filet mignon cooked medium-rare over a bed of grilled asparagus & fingerling potatoes. (Sofia Italian Steakhouse, West Roxbury)

Honey, this coffee cake was berry berry delicious. beehiveboston offers coffee cake du jour with honey butter topped with powdered sugar & berries. The cake was moist & crispy on the bottom. Perfect balance of flavors (The Beehive, Boston)

This dish was so eggcellent, we must toast! This is called the eggs shashuka offered during weekend brunch at beehiveboston. It has poached eggs with North African style tomato sauce, polenta, toast & merguez spiced lamb. It was my first time having anything like it, & it was delicious. (The Beehive, Boston)

flatbreadprovidence stole a pizza my heart after serving me this pie. This was one of their specials yesterday. It consists of corn, cheese, aioli & greens. It was delish! Would’ve wanted more corn, cheese, & aioli...but now I’m prepared for next time (Flatbread Co., Providence RI)

The hollandaise are over, but the good eats don’t end! We can continue to have egg -stremely delicious meals, such as this Popeyes’s eggs Benedict with spinach & tomatoes with a side of home fries. My go-to breakfast dish is always an eggs Benedict. (Brookside Cafe, Norwood MA)

I’m apple -solutely impressed with this dish from ravensnestpub. You have to goat try this apple goat cheese salmon. It’s an 8oz pan seared salmon served with grilled asparagus, mashed potatoes & cranberry cinnamon balsamic. I’m not usually a huge fan of salmon dishes...but this was basically perfection. The flavors were so well balanced & the salmon was so crispy at the bottom. (Raven’s Nest, Walpole)
Don’t get crabby...get crab cakes from daviosrestaurant instead. This oven baked lump crab cake served with whole grain mustard was absolutely delicious. (Davio’s, Foxborough MA)

Roll on over to ravensnestpub for the best risotto balls. These are fried mozzarella stuffed lemon saffron risotto balls served with some kind of tomato sauce & pesto. These are one of the best rice balls I’ve ever, highly recommend! (Raven’s Nest, Walpole MA)

I’d brussel some feathers to get a piece of these seared scallops from ilmassimorestaurants. The flavors & execution of this dish will make your tastebuds sprout. These local scallops are seared & served with butternut squash risotto, pancetta & brussel sprouts. Honestly one of the best scallop/risotto dishes I’ve had! (Il Massimo, Dedham)

Being a foodie tater-tot me a lot...like how I wouldn’t be happy without food. This tater tot poutine from bostoniapublichouse was delicious! These crispy tater tots were served with black pepper brown gravy, melted cheese & green onions. Such a simple dish, but really hit the spot. (Bostonia Public House, Boston)

Feeling crabby? Let’s get crackin’ at thecapitalgrille. These lobster and crab cakes with corn slaw was phenomenal. The size, flavor & dipping sauce were just to die for, definitely recommend. (Capital Grille, Boston)

I’ll sparagus your search for good food, cause make no mis-steak....it is found here at strega.italiano. I wanted to gar-lick this plate. For Valentine’s Day we dined here & my got the filet mignon medium rare with a side of mashed potatoes and asparagus. The meat was tender with great flavor, & we loved the freshly roasted garlic...major key (Strega Italians, Seaport Boston)

Quail-come to the cutest sushi/Thai spot sanryoka & thaiamarin. This appetizer is tartar-ific. Featured here is the tuna tartare with fresh cuts of tuna, homemade tartare sauce, scallion, tobiko, avocado & quail egg on top of seaweed. Presentation was absolutely beautiful & taste was delicious! (Sanryoka at Thai Amarin, Newton MA)

Whoever made this deserves a pad (thai) on the back because it was shrimply delicious. I got the spicy shrimp pad thai from thaiamarin. These rice noodles are wok fried with eggs, crushed, bean sprouts, scallions, tamarind juice & spiced with cayenne pepper. Of course I asked for extra sauce; might’ve went overboard with that request. I especially loved the flavor & juiciness of the shrimp. (Thai Amarin, Newton MA)

Curry, summer is coming...& I’m trying to catch these gains & get as many mussels as I can. cavrestaurant served these Prince Edward Island mussels in a coconut red curry sauce. It was absolutely phenomenal & you bet we slurped that sauce up! (CAV Restaurant, Providence RI)

This appetizer was taro-iffic. cavrestaurant serves this pistachio crusted jumbo crab cake with siracha aioli & taro root chips. This has to be too 3 crab cakes I’ve ever had. I really liked the consistency of the crab & the flavor of the aioli. What really did it for me was the crispy taro chips. (CAV Restaurant, Providence RI)

I had a grape (tomato) time at ilmassimorestaurants the other week. I was amazed at their lunch deal & want to go there everyday for it. We had the bruschetta bites & Caesar salad for our appetizers. Super refreshing & delicious! (Il Massimo, Dedham)

Let me espresso myself: this espresso martini from trattoriailpanino was perfection! This drink had Absolut vanilla, Bailey’s, Kahlua, Frangelico, Disaronno, Espresso, sugar & a cocoa rum. Boy did this drink make me feel fun & energized! Certainly the best espresso martini I’ve had. (Trattoria Il Panino)

Meals like these are the best for sharing: Gotta give me some, her some, him some & dim sum. Dim sum is a traditional Chinese meal made up of small plates, especially dumplings. Trust me, it is the most delicious & fun eating experience. Here is a picture of my favorite dessert when eating dim sum...steamed custard buns. (China Star, Lowell)

thejuicebarnorwood has the berry berry best smoothie bowls I’ve ever tried!!! They give you a survey and you just check mark smoothie base & toppings! I always get ALL the fruits with seeds, condensed milk & honey. I legit love this place for breakfast, after a workout, or even after my racquetball sessions with my boyfriend haha.

It is one of the beer-y best times in the year...where the sun is shining & you can sip some beer & eat some yums outside. Had a great time visiting trilliumcanton the other week while snacking on some keanes_wood_fired bites. So sad that they sold out of the mushroom sandwich. However, the pickled assortment dish, nachos & pulled pork sandwich did not disappoint (Keane’s Pop-up trilliumcanton)

This pasta dish was so cluckin’ good. I usually choose seafood over chicken…but this dish really was the breast chicken dish I’ve had in a while. This is the chicken Romano: which entails a mozzarella & garlic filled chicken breast & white wine sauce with rigatoni pasta. The chicken was so juicy & full of flavor, definitely impressed me. (Sardella’s, Newport RI)

Cheezus christ…this meal was so good I had to chick-en with you all about it. Do you see that cheese pull?! This is the cheesy boneless chicken, soy garlic flavor. There was like a 1:1 ratio of cheese & chicken…which is a hit in my book (Den Den Korean Fried Chicken, Providence RI)

Torch my food & I will fish-nish you. Here’s a beautiful look at the torched salmon appetizer at douzosushi. It was topped with scallions, tobiko & some yummy sauce served on top of a sweet crab meat salad. Loved the flavor & freshness of everything

This was an egg-cellent test kitchen selection at lincolnsouthbos. It was rib-dicously delicious. If you touched my plate…we’d certainly have to hash it out. Here is the short ribs eggs benedict that has chili braised short rib, arepas, corn salsa, poached egg, house hot sauce & hollandaise. (Lincoln Tavern, Boston)

If you don’t want to go ham with a big heavy lunch…this is the perfect light but fulfilling selection! This is the chef’s salad from farmerinthedell_walpole. This salad typically comes with bib lettuce, ham, Swiss cheese, cucumber, picked veggies, red onions & tarragon dressing. I also added a fried egg in there cause I can. (Farmer in the Dell, Walpole)

Taco bout a yummy lunch! O-fish-ally in a food coma after this variety of tacos. I’m not porkin’ kidding…it really put me to sleep. We tried the mushroom, fish, pork belly, duck, and lobster tacos!! They were all delicious (Bartaco, Boston MA)

What’s soup everyone? Hope you’re having a grain Sunday. Be-leaf me, you need to stop at pressedcafe for a meal. I tried one of their power bowls this afternoon. This is the Mediterranean salmon bowl. (Pressed Cafe, Newton MA)

This is the most koala-tea drink from tastetearolls on this beautiful summer day. If you’ve never had rose milk tea…you’re missing out! I want this in a gallon please. There’s a perfect balance of rose tea aromatics & sweetness *chefs kiss* (Tastetea Rolls, Worcester MA)

It’s always going to be a crepe day if you start it with breakfast at liviasdish. This is my absolute favorite savory crepe, the smoked salmon crepe. It has smoked salmon, yogurt sauce, capers, cucumber & onion topped with chipotle aioli. (Livia’s Dish, Worcester MA)

This appetizer will keep you cheesing & wonton more. Here are the Buffalo chicken wontons from flyingrhinocafe that comes with buttermilk dip. They were super crispy & then warm/melty inside (Flying Rhino, Worcester MA)

This was the zest app we tried from offtherailsworcester the other night. Be-claws a chick loves her seafood. Their Maryland crab cakes have lump crab, lemon, panko, peppers, herbs, old bay Mayo & grilled lemon. It was flavorful, balanced & texture great…I really liked the Mayo that it game with. It was definitely the top appetizer out of the four items we tried. (Off the Rails, Worcester MA)

Roll up so I can tail you about bomb eats. We tried the Crouching Tiger Makimono at Koy near Faneuil Hall. This maki roll comes with 8 pieces of tempura shrimp, cream cheese, avocado, cucumber, topped w/ torched salmon, avocado, surimi imitation crab, unagi sauce, sesame & tobiko…it was perfection
I go coconuts for a good time at timeoutmarketboston. What are your favorite spots/dishes to get when you’re at Time Out Market in Boston??

You rare-ly find a burger this delicious…I swear! And if you got an issue with how I like my burgers (medium rare)….save your beef & negativity for someone else. This is the amazing surf & turf burger from brew.city. It’s a prime burger with melted Havarti cheese, baby mixed greens, sliced tomato, lobster salad & roasted garlic mayo served on a butter toasted ciabatta roll. (Brew City, Worcester MA)

If you order this….I’ll be honest…I’ll be jalapeño business tryna sneak a bite. This was in funkymurphys special menu the other week, can’t find it in their regular menu right now. But it is a chicken jalapeño avocado salad. It has fried jalapeños, avocado, cheese, onions, tomatoes. salsa, & lettuce served with the most delicious dressing (can’t remember the name ). (Funky Murphy’s, Worcester MA)

I can’t beer to see you all miss out on delicious & beautiful/glittery beer from rr_brewingco. So glad to be living near Shrewsbury St., just steps away from this safe haven. This is the Sh-booms beer that they have on tap! It’s an English style best bitter with edible gold glitter, pops with aromas of graham cracker, cherry & plum, features biscuity & toffee flavors & a hint of spice. (Redemption Rock Brewing Co., Worcester MA)

This dish macs me smile real cheesy. This is the blackened chicken mac n cheese from brew.city. It has blackened chicken breast, Cellentani pasta, creamy Béchamel sauce, diced tomatoes, scallions & Monterey Jack cheese. Not only was the dish full of flavor, but the portion was oh so generous (Brew City, Worcester MA)

What the shell! These scallops from lock_50 were yummy! These seared scallops are considered a small plate. They come with sweet corn purée, chive oil, watercress & pepper salad. It was actually a very refreshing snack. The scallops are smaller than expected, & cooked through a little more than I usually like. But I enjoyed it, & thought the salad was perfect (Lock 50, Worcester MA)
I always have a great Thai-m when I’m eating this dish. Whoever made it, needs a pad (Thai) on the back. I always get shrimp pad Thai with some spice & extra sauce (Thai Place, Shrewsbury)

Corn on over to lock_50 & enjoy a prime (sirloin) meal like we did on date night last week. This 12oz sirloin was served with street corn salsa, roasted peppers & chipotle reduction. Ya girl loves anything with corn & the sirloin was cooked exactly how we wanted (Lock50, Worcester MA)

Currently have an eggtreme craving for some carbonara. It’s truly impastable to resist such a meal. ilmassimorestaurants has this spaghetti alla carbonara with guanciale, raw farm egg, pecorino Romano & crushed black pepper. Such a simple but delicious meal (Il Massimo, Dedham MA)

Had a crepe brunch at lock_50. If you go, make sure you make mushroom in your belly beforehand. I was told that the crepes were a must try…so I chose the mushroom crepe. It has mushrooms, Swiss cheese & fresh herbs. It was so simple…but soooo delicious. I love cheese & mushroom so I couldn’t go wrong. I would definitely go back for brunch! (Lock50, Worcester MA)

How can you resist poutine this in your mouth…I will never know. It comes with a russet fries, foie gras gravy, cheddar curds, pickled shallots, scallion & fried egg. It was one of the best poutine dishes that I’ve ever had! (Lock50, Worcester MA)

Let’s get down to the nitty grits-y…lock_50 has the absolute best brunch I’ve had…period. We stopped here during the canal district fall stroll for brunch. Pictured here is the chicken & grits. It has spicy fried chicken, cheddar grits, cheese sauce, green tomato relish, & a fried egg. (Lock50, Worcester MA)

Aw snap, this lobster sandwich was a beast. It had crispy prosciutto, arugula, lemon mayo, & grilled challah bread. The lobster tasted good, but I couldn’t really taste or see the crispy prosciutto, & it was ALOT of arugula. Was yummy, but definitely wouldn’t get it again for $40 something. (The Cottage, Wellesley MA)
Brunch at lock_50 sips hard

If I were you, I’d be on(ion) my way to thaiplacerestaurant for a meal. You’d leave having a rice rest of the day. Here’s the lemongrass chicken which has marinated chicken fried until crisp & sautéed with onions, carrots, ginger, & peanuts served with steamed veggies & white rice (for lunch). It carries such great flavor & balance with the vegetables (Thai Place, Shrewsbury)

roundups.title: Tina’s Instagram eats, 2022
roundups.excerpt: Tina’s 2022 Instagram posts from around Massachusetts and New England. Menus and businesses may have changed since.

videos.caption: You’ll always have a rice day after visiting Windsor Dim Sum cafe in Chinatown, Boston. Dim sum is basically tapas style…order a bunch of small dishes & feast with friends/family. My absolutely hands down favorite dish are rice noodles! They’re stuffed & topped with all different types of fillings…my favorite is shrimp. They also come with a mildly sweet & savory soy sauce, I always ask for extra

Brunch here is lock_50 & loaded with the best dishes! This hands down has been my favorite brunch spot. Here we got the hash, which has ham, Yukon potatoes, sweet onion, brussels sprouts, dijon hollandaise, & a fried egg (Lock50, Worcester MA)

This is the ravi-only thing I’ve been thinking about during the snow storm. I can’t espresso how delicious trattoriailpanino is. We got ravioli con aragosta & the ravioli porcini…both which were clawsome. I also loved how they came out in cute pans. Can’t wait to go back (Trattoria Il Panino, Boston MA)

I would be an impasta if I said I didn’t want to eat all this. Stop ca-noodling around and stop by ilmassimorestaurants for a bite. I especially love their Happy Hour. Here’s the chicken parmigiana with breaded & pan fried chicken, mozzarella, San Marzano tomato sauce & rigatoni (il Massimo, Dedham MA)

It’s a crepe day to be alive when you get one of these from baobaobakery! A bite of this makes the tough days absolute cake. Crepe cakes are literally perfection…thin layers of crepes stacked together with thin layers of the most delicious cream. It just tastes so decadent & subtle…& melts in your mouth. I love that it’s not too sweet. This strawberry one was absolute perfection (Bao Bao Bakery, Boston MA)

Chili out with a warm flavorful bowl of ramen at kuuramen. Trust me, your tastebuds will be soy in love. Kuu chili ramen has spicy ground chicken, Kakuni pork, marinated egg, Naruto, arugula, green onions, bean sprouts, bamboo, garlic chips, sesame, chili skin & chili oil. I added corn of course! It was so flavorful (Kuu Ramen, NYC)

Can’t stress hummus we enjoyed beirut_bite yesterday for lunch! I love Mediterranean cuisine, & how light/healthy it is. 1. Hummus: Always a great choice, & look how pretty it came out! 2. Greek salad : So well seasoned & mixed, I’m definitely a salad girl! 3. Falafel: Crispy on the outside, & fluffy on the inside. Also came with tahini, tomatoes, & pickled veggie 4.
Feeling so hoppy now that we are getting a taste of warm weather & sunshine. Always love the beer selection, decor, puppies, & amazing vibes at rr_brewingcoz! (Redemption Brewing Co., Worcester MA)

Taco bout beautiful weather….let’s have a shell of a time this weekend! We love going to bartacolife an assortment of tacos. Last time we went, we got the lobster special, not sure if they’re offering it now. It has lobster, scallops, & cilantro. Isn’t she gorgeous?

I will never baguette how good this Banh Mi from mama__saigon tasted for lunch today. Mama Saigon offers authentic Vietnamese Banh Mis (basically sandwiches in a baguette). They offer a variety of proteins, I chose their Banh Mi egg with pate, Vietnamese Mayo, pickled carrots & daikon, cilantro, cucumber, & jalapeños. They are taking pick up orders only (weekends).

This turkey dinner had me stuffed. I was (cran)berry happy! oconnorsrestaurant served this turkey dinner with white & dark turkey meat, mashed potatoes, gravy, sweet potatoes, stuffing, & cranberry sauce. Serving size was awesome (O’Connors)

Had a shell of a time at fishrestaurantandwinebar! This Lobster Bake special was claw-some…we left happy as clams. This whole lobster came with potatoes, sausage, mussels, shrimp, clams, & corn in a savory broth. Things got messy, but it was worth it. (Fish Restaurant, Marlboro MA)

(Oy)ster the pot with a delicious order of kaki fry from Kinzen in Marlboro. What is that you may ask?? Amazingly breaded & deep fried oysters served with katsu mayo sauce over a bed of thin sliced cabbage. These were hands down the best fried oysters I’ve ever had! The meat inside was sooo decadent & tasty. I need to go back for more of these!

Miso happy to have had the opportunity to slurp these noodles. It was eggcellent & soup-er delicious! I tried the spicy miso ramen. It has a spicy pork broth, Chashu pork, Japanese bamboo, wood ear mushroom, corn, scallions, & sesame seeds. I also added a marinated soft boiled egg (the best part). (Kinzen, Marlboro MA)

Honey, you need to slide on over to laurasbarandgrill for these amazing sliders! Met up with some foodie friends [ chaustahhh, amp_eats, & tarahdevoursma ] for a bite. We shared these hot honey sliders…they came with seasoned chicken tossed in hot honey & topped with pickles & ranch drizzle. These were absolutely fantastic…the chicken was big, crispy, & well seasoned. (Laura’s Bar & Grill, Smithfield RI)

Udon know what you’re missing out on…you just check out doragonramenma! The broth was so refreshing & the toppings were eggcellent. They had fish cake, soft boiled eggs, scallions, bok choy, bamboo, & bean sprouts. Also loved that the shrimp tempura (3) came on the side to keep it crispy (Doragon Ramen, Ashland MA)

If you’ve never rolled into Ming’s Seafood Restaurant & Dim Sum in Malden…I feel bad for you. My go-to at dim sum is any kind of steamed rice rolls. Here is fried dough inside of a steamed rice noodle topped with cilantro. It’s served with sweet soy sauce & the combo is utter perfection
A ramen-tic lunch broth to you by doragonramenma. (Doragon Ramen, Ashland MA)

This sashimi lunch is so-fish-ticated. It comes with salmon, tuna, shrimp, & another fish that I don’t remember. It tasted fresh & the cuts were beautiful. Also love the lunch deal, this was $20.50. (Fuji at Assembly, Somerville MA)

It’s a wrap…. chopkabob is a must-try. I got the lamb tip kabob wrap. It came with lettuce, tomatoes, & a sauce. The meat could have been more tender, and cut into smaller pieces, but it was yummy. I definitely love the yogurt dips that they sell in tubs (Chop Kabob, Westboro)

Dough you have any idea how delicious this slice is?! It holds a pizza my heart, & has me cheesing from ear to ear! centralpizza_woo served this perfection…we ordered a Hawaiian with banana peppers. The pizza came out fast & delicious (Central Pizza, Worcester MA)

Jolloff….but I’d sell my arm for unlimited akraeatery. I never (cole) slaw it coming…but after my first bite…I knew I was in love. They’re located in the woopublicmarket, & serve African cuisine. You select your base, protein, & three sides. I typically get joloff rice (tomato & herb infused rice), salmon, corn, cole slaw, carrots, & I pay extra for plantains [cause I can’t just choose 3 ]. (Akra Eatery, Worcester MA)

If you just wanna relax, chill(i), & enjoy a delicious meal…I’d check out lock_50. This is the lemongrass chicken that comes with chilled noodles & some chili sauce. The chicken was so flavorful & crispy. The noodles were so refreshing! The portion size was small…but it was so yummy (Lock50, Worcester MA)
akraeatery

Dough you want to start the day off right? If so, I think it starts with a mochi donut. mochidoh_worcester offers chewy & fluffy mochi donuts of different flavors! I tried the strawberry shortcake & my sister got the churro. (Mochi Doh, Worcester MA)

Is it pasta-ble to not like pasta?! Cause I don’t think so. This carbonara from theantiquetablelynn was delicious! They make their pasta fresh, so that linguine was a treat. The carbonara had sautéed prosciutto, red onions, & Romano cheese in house Alfredo sauce (Antique Table, Lynne MA)

roundups.excerpt: Tina’s 2023 Instagram posts from around Massachusetts and New England. Menus and businesses may have changed since.

videos.caption: I’m so porkin’ happy that kinzennoodles broth this ramen to my table. I got the Tan Tan Ramen, which is spicy pork broth with chashu pork, egg, chili oil, spicy ground pork, bok choy, bean sprouts, & scallions. I also added some mushrooms. It had a very mild kick, & definitely made me feel warm inside.

Pub122 took amazing curry of us. It was our first time there, & I promise it won’t be our last. This chicken tikka masala was one of the best I’ve had. The service, ambiance, & food at pub122northgrafton were impressive. Definitely recommend

If you check out guiebcafe…I promise ube so delighted. We got their ube mascarpone pancakes topped with their famous ube sauce and fresh berries. It was to die for! And it came out so hot & steamy…can’t wait to go back (Guieb Cafe, Honolulu HI)
The brunch at lock_50 is eggcellent…totally my jam. The fried chicken & grits comes with a green tomato jam & a fried egg. I’ve gotten this multiple times…it’s so delicious (Lock50, Worcester MA)

We got beef if you don’t like Thai food. I wanna pad-see-you slurping on these noods. My second favorite Thai noodle dish is pad see ew. It is stir fried short/fat rice noodles with vegetables & your choice of protein. There’s so much flavor & it hits the spot (Thai Place, Shrewsbury)

Suns out…buns out. Particularly…buns with delicious lobster meat inside! Our favorite item from the Worcester Food Truck Festival yesterday was this classic lobster roll from thelobsterroller! The lobster meat tasted so fresh & they did NOT skimp (The Lobster Rollers (Foodtruck))

I’m waffly impressed with the bubble tea soft serve now available at gc_worcester! It is so smooth & creamy They offer oolong milk tea, taro milk tea, & regular milk tea flavors. You can even do a twist! You pick a cup or with a waffle, & toppings too. I highly recommend the crystal boba (Gong Cha, Worcester MA)

You’ve gotta be chicken kidding me…cause this was one of the best chicken sandwiches I’ve ever had. Their chicken was crispy on the outside and super juicy on the inside. The house sauce had a nice kick, the slaw was perfect, the pickles were fresh, & the bun was delicious (Halal Eatz, Burlington MA)

You’ve hit the hot pot if you order this from Thai Place. It is a well kept secret that they have this huge hot pot serving for a reasonable price. It typically comes with tom yum broth, which is tomato-y flavored. We got ours tom kha style (coconut broth). It has seafood: mussels, scallops, shrimp, squid, imitation crab, & fish. It also comes with tomatoes, onions, & mushrooms.
This will leave you wonton more…I swear. These spicy shrimp wontons from doragonramenma were immaculate. I love anything smothered in sauce. It also felt light & fresh (Doragon Ramen, Ashland MA)

Donut fret…boba tea awaits at kimochiworcester! This has been the cutest boba addition to Worcester. They’re located on Shrewsbury Street & have a nice ambiance. The drinks were delicious (I tried thai tea & mango green tea) & their donuts from pinkudonuts were the perfect consistency & flavor! I tried the pistachio (my favorite) & churro

Let’s gyoza to hongnoodle68 & stuff our faces! Cause this steamed gyoza was one of the best I’ve ever had. There was something special about the wrapper texture & they perfected it with the chili sauce & garnish…I’m having flashbacks just thinking about it (Hong’s Noodle Bar, Dover NH)

I could never get thai-ed of boba tea. It is my one true love in life. It was such a pleasure to check out the new kimochiworcester! The thai tea was well flavored & the boba was a great consistency. I got regular sugar/ice & it came out just right! You also NEED to check out the inside…so aesthetic & cute

I am so grilled to check out brillacoffee! They started as a roastery, & now have two coffee shops that serve way more than just coffee! Everything was so fresh & delicious. You can tell they put great care in their food/drinks. This is our favorite food item there so far. It is called El Nica Pastrami. The meat was so tender & flavorful & went so well with the pesto & melted cheese. (Brilla Coffee, Holden)

I can’t espresso what a great visit we had to brillacoffee! The ambiance and aesthetic inside was delightful. They also have a drive-thru! And of course….they have so many flavors of delicious locally roasted coffee. I got the Horchata Coffee (Brilla Coffee, Holden MA)

Don’t make a mis-steak by not checking out comeketo_brazilian_steakhouse! This was one of the best Brazilian Steakhouse experiences I’ve ever had. I rarely go out for meats…but this place is a gem! I loved the selection at the salad bar, especially the lobster bisque. It was so hard to pick my favorite meat…they were all so tender & flavorful. (Comeketo Brazilian Steakhouse, Leominster MA)
Ever think about checking out the restaurant inside of Union Station [Worcester, MA]? We did! And we totally recommend it! (Luciano’s Restaurant, Worcester MA)
I know y’all have been curious about this place! Definitely recommend (All Systems Go, Worcester MA [ allsystemsgoma ])
Spencer Fair: rides, food, drinks, art, animals, & games!
Pause for details on the delectables you see ! (Brilla Coffee, Holden MA)

Forge & Vine is a Massachusetts gem Had a wonderful foodie experience with my foodie pals. I can’t wait to go back! forgeandvine served up: Seafood tower Charcuterie board Cashew chicken Mussels Risotto Wagyu burger Pork-chop Pasta Tomahawk steak alyshas621 ’s Fall desserts
Come eat at pinkbellies with us

Would you pay $178 for an 18 course Omakase at umamiomakase? There were so many delicious dishes
I love arts and crafts…so let’s go to claytimestudio to paint some pottery!

roundups.excerpt: Fresh coconuts in Cancún!

videos.caption: Fresh coconuts in Cancún!

Tropical drinks all day everyday out here on Isla Mujeres, Mexico. This amazing mango fruit shake is made from real mangos with small mango pieces, it was so refreshing. (Penguinos, la Isla Mujeres (Mexico))
Nothing more like vacation than eating fresh island fruit (Penguinos, Isla Mujeres (Mexico))

Hope everyone has an eggcellent weekend although you may not be on vacation in Cancun. One of the better breakfast dishes I had on vacation was this eggs montuleños. It's a traditional Yucatecan dish with two fried eggs served on a corn tortilla with ham, peas, red sauce, beans, and fried plantains. Talk about loaded eggs... (Penguinos, Isla Mujeres (Mexico))
When I had real Mexican elote straight from the streets of Cancún. It was corn on the cob layered with lime juice, mayo, cheese, and spice. (Street Vendor, Cancún MX)
Happy from these nachos I got during my trip to Cancún. Taco bout legit nachos. (Grand Oasis Resort, Cancún MX)

roundups.title: Toronto eats
roundups.excerpt: This spicy ramen from touhenbokuramen is pork'in delish!

videos.caption: This spicy ramen from touhenbokuramen is pork'in delish! This signature bowl has sea salt, pork belly, cloud ear mushroom, green onion, nitamago (salted egg ), & thick noodles. The ingredients & broth worked really well together, felt really flavorful/authentic. I really liked the pork belly that melted in my mouth & the egg that added a lot of flavahhh. (Touhenboku Ramen, Toronto)

You're tastebuds will surely benny-fit if you stop at socokitchenbar in Toronto. Hands down the best brunch food I've ever had. Place is super clean, well decorated, & staff were fire. But most importantly everything was cooked to perfection. (Soco Kitchen + Bar, Toronto)

The best moment of my life: when I poutine this in my mouth. This was by far the best poutine I ever had in my life. It had fries (of course), duck, gravy, cheesy cheese, & a side of cranberry sauce. It was so good I almost cried. (Cafe in CN Tower, Toronto)

This brunch dish was avocado control. The avocado toast is served w/ tomato chutney, whipped ricotta, poached eggs, pickled mustard seeds, & breakfast potatoes w/ herb salad. Hands down the best avocado toast I've ever had. Just the quality of ingredients & the combination of flavors....I can't praise socokitchenbar enough!! (Soco Kitchen +Bar, Toronto)

roundups.title: The Big E, 2017
roundups.excerpt: This Mexican pizza will get jalopeno tastebuds.

videos.caption: This Mexican pizza will get jalopeno tastebuds. I think this is the best thing I've ever eaten at thebigefair. It is toasted crispy and topped with chicken (or steak ), cheese, jalopenos, tomato salsa, and onions. Best choice I ever made. (The Big E Fair, Springfield)

Donut pass this up if you go to thebigefair. I think this might have been the sole reason we had to go to The Big E this year. The smores donut special by The Donut Family has fresh warm mini donuts covered with cinnamon sugar, chocolate syrup, mini marshmallows, and whipped cream. It melted in your mouth and traveled to your veins.

videos.caption: Do yourself a favor...try their coffee. Also this turkey bacon sandwich though (it's REALLY crunchy/toasted, so consider asking them to toast lightly)...9/10!
This loaded wrap from technimediterraneangrill needs to be in my mouth right now. You can load them with whatever your heart desires with amazingly fresh ingredients. I'm in love. Ugh.
May your weekend be sweet & amazing...like these green tea eggettes from doublechinbos

This is the S'mores dessert from sweetworcester. It has house made smoked marshmellows, chocolate & peanut butter cookies with a fire for toasting. I prefer my marshmellows burnt. This was worth all the calories it tasted SO GOOD.
Chocolate fondue upon request at sweetworcester. It came with assortments of marshmellows, apple slices, rice crispies, clementines and bananas! Hope this gives you some sweet dreams.

But....this South-Westside flat bread pizza from cornergrille was dhakfsaoqhjtkajrhrg AMAZING. It's topped with sweet BBQ sauce, chicken, red onion, cilantro & cheese. The thin crust was spectacular. Not only did it taste great, but it didn't make me feel so bloated & heavy. Please try their pies if you haven't ever had it before, it is something magical!
Holy moly...look at these cannolis from whollycannoli that lit my insides up.
Taco bites from Chef Lewin (jdlewin) today at cochon555. Not only were these taco bites (barbacoa on a chicarron taco) delicious, but so were their sausages.
One of my favorite bites from yesterday cochon555 is this wheat bread topped with cheese and guava preserve. It was such a delectable combo placed by. These were BOMB.

Chicken caesar salad flatbread pie from cornergrilleworcester really hit the spot for lunch today. Its topped with diced tomato, chicken, lettuce, parmesan cheese and caesar dressing. It amazes me how they make the bread so crisp, yet it melts in your mouth after a few bites. Love it. I told them I'm gonna have to try every one of their pies before I die.

Had the most amazing time at bbc_worcester for an eat & greet today. Tasting of 10 of their dishes was fantastic, extremely impressed. Thanks for starting off the night with this amazing cheese board, such a variety! So much more posts to come on such beautiful & delicious dishes from British Beer Company, so excited to share!

This seared tuna sashimi from britishbeercompany bbc_worcester was mind-blowing. It's served rare with togarashi spice, pickled seaweed, & grilled pineapple. It's amazing what the chefs there are capable of, you need to try the variety of items on their menu! Tasted so refreshing, ahhh. Also....presenation is always beautiful. (British Beer Company, Worcester)

Check out these buns. It's the British Beer Burger from britishbeercompany bbc_worcester. It has bacon jam, English ale mustard, double Gloucester cheese, baby arugula, and tomato on brioche buns. It comes with deliciously crispy fries and a pickle slice. Burger had the perfect combination of flavors in such a juicy patty. Happy fry-day my fellow foodies. (British Beer Company, Worcester)

By far my favorite roll that I've tasted in this lifetime. This Sakura roll from babasushisturbridge is the definition of good sushi, I was blown away. This is one of their special rolls that may not appear on the menu. It has tuna and crab with avocado, asparagus, and a hint of crunch on the inside. It is topped with bluefin tuna and avocado served with special yuzu sauce for dipping. (Baba Sushi, Sturbridge)

Hands down the best oysters I've ever had in my life. This is the Sumo Oyster Supreme from babasushisturbridge. They're oysters served in a half shell with citrus sauce, tobasco, black caviar, and scallions. Never in my life did I have such fresh and tasty oysters, I feel like all the oysters I had before that was a lie.

Springing it up with this amazing sushi spring roll appetizer from babasushisturbridge. It comes with four pieces of spring rolls with crabmeat, steamed shrimp, fresh mango, and masago in a cucumber wrapped topped with honey wasabi sauce. It tasted so amazing and fresh. (Baba Sushi, Sturbridge)

If you eat this, you better salmon some if you don't finish. This is the teriyaki salmon dish from britishbeercompany bbc_worcester. The salmon is grilled with shitake-edamame succotash, enoki, seaweed salad, red potatoes, and orange ginger broth. So colorful and delicious. (British Beer Company, Worcester)

What's the best thing on hump day?! Carbs and cheese...hence, PIZZA. Wanted my tastebuds to feel like they were on vacation...so I got the Maui Waui pizza from dacostaspizzabakery! They're pizzas are oh so quality. It has pineapple bacon jalapeno jam, black forest ham, fried rosemary, and fresh mozzarella fontina. So damn delicious. (Dacosta's Pizza Bakery, Worcester)
What do you do once the weather gets sunny and warm?! Eat ice cream obviously. (Madulka's Ice Cream, Worcester)
Got my fix of Korean Bibimbap post gym workout today. Got the spicy chicken with hot paste with veggies and rice. Definitely hit the spot. (Tutti Frutti, Worcester)
Obligatory ice cream post cause it's outside today. (Madulka's Ice Cream)

I can eat a pizza bagel for breakfast cause it's a bagel right? Bagel topped with marinara sauce, cheese, and sausage. This was oh so delicious, you need to try it, it'll change your world. (N&J Donuts)

Always comforting to eat a hardy breakfast at the the local diner. Got the vegetable breakfast sandwich on wheat bread with egg, cheese, tomato, mushroom, broccoli, green peppers, and spinach with a side of their homemade hot salsa. Also with some home fries cause carbs are life. (Annie's Clark Brunch)
Summer calls for festival/carnival yums! Went to the Fanelli Carnival in Oxford last weekend. Couldn't resist cheese fries with bacon bits.

The way you sizzle makes me wanna tapas that. Check out this shrimp tapa from barcelonawinebar. So juicy and flavorful. Big thank you to yummyventures for our giftcard that blessed us with serious yums! (Barcelona Wine Bar, Brookline)
We made it to day! Hope the rest of the week is fruitful...like this fruit cake. (Top Bread, Chinatown Boston)

May your day be bright and glistening as this sweet and sour chicken. The outside was so crispy and saucy while the inside was so juicy and tender. Boy I love balance. (New Shanghai, Chinatown Boston)

Holy ravioli...this is delicious. This squash blossom mascarpone ravioli dish from thecitizenwinebar was yummy yummy in my tummy. The dish contains green beans, sugar snap pea, heirloom tomato, green garlic cream, and herb bread crumb. It was flavorable, but not too heavy on the stomach. It was also very unique in flavor, I loved the hint of sweetness from the squash. (The Citizen Wine Bar, Worcester)

I don't want to be shellfish, but I'm not sharing this shrimp dish cause it's too delish. This is the pan roasted cajun shrimp from thecitizenwinebar. It's served with tasso ham and sugar snap pea rissoto with orange blood aioli. Nice and soothing on the taste buds. (The Citizen Wine Bar, Worcester)

Can't wait for tastetearolls_ to open so yall can roll on in and taste some tastetea thangs. It was matcha delicious! This is the matcha green tea flavored ice cream roll with condensed milk and mochi red bean. I topped it with whipped cream, oreo sprinkles, and a green tea pocky stick. (Tastetea Rolls, Worcester)

Hope you have a ball this weekend, like this salmon avocado ball from bonchonchicken in Allston. This dish contains a mix of avocado, crab meat, cucumber, and fish roe wrapped in seared fresh salmon topped with spicy mayo, unagi sauce and crunchy tempura bites.

Happy national ice cream day from this cotton candy flavored ice. Perfect for a hot day. Also super light on the stomach. I loved it. cocostropicalice has a variety of flavors for ice as well as soft serve, definitely a place to hit during the summer. (Coco's Tropical Ice)

Since it's Monday and the least favorite day of the week, I will let you in on a secret. Here is where you get the best Italian food you've ever eaten...biagio_ristorante. I hate going out for Italian because I typically get disappointed. But this place truly eggplanted a seed in my heart. I had the eggplant bracciolalettini for an appetizer. (Biagio Ristorante, Waltham)
Rose up this morning craving milk tea from tastetearolls_. (Tastetea Rolls, Worcester)

We donut miss out on food-centered events. New England Food Truck Festival nefoodtruckfest today was forktastic. Check out this almond butter crunch square donut from tonyssquaredonuts who has been voted top 50 donuts in the US. Video coming soon. (Tony's Square Donuts, NE Food Truck Fest)

Ya gotta get your buns to a food truck festival. You sea, this sea scallop roll may have been my favorite item at the nefoodtruckfest this past weekend. This contains a quarter pound of fresh wild Atlantic sea scallops directly from the fishing vessel Karen Elizabeth, seared to perfection and stuffed into a buttery grilled roll. (Shuckin' Truck, New Englad Food Truck Fest)

The inside scoop with the chameleonworcester today was so impressive! Their name comes from their menu adaptation to the seasons...like a chameleon! I was in awe of all the variety of unique items they had on their menu, I wanted to try everything. Not only that, but 85% of their menu is made/or can be made gluten free. They also offer vegan options.

You gotta brisket to get the biscuit (cornbread ). I know you've seen cheese boards...but have you seen a meat board chameleonworcester?! This is the meat combo with brisket, half chicken, and pulled pork with a side of corn bread and mac n' cheese. They have a great selection of house-made BBQ sauces to pair with their dishes. (The Chameleon, Worcester)

The best type of men...are ramen. Had a great time at thehangoverpub tonight. I had to get the three pork ramen. This bowl contained bacon dashi, pork shoulder, fried egg, noodles, nori, bacon, pork belly and scallions in a heart warming broth. It tasted full of flavor. Though it was slightly salty for me, you bet I still ate it all. Staff was super friendly and atmosphere was welcoming. (The Hangover Pub, Worcester)

I don't wanna sound cheesy, but this dish was grate. This mac n cheese must be one of the best mac n cheeses I've had. The perfect balance between macaroni and cheese at chameleonworcester, you can even add pulled pork. (The Chameleon, Worcester)

These cupcakes bake me crazy. Congratulations to thequeenscups on their new location! We stopped by for some delicious goodies. I got the nutella french toast (front right), carrot cake (front left), red velvet (back right), and butterscotch caramel almond cannoli (back left). My top two were definitely the carrot cake and red velvet, the cream cheese filling was such a major key.

Clam the shuck down...its. Here is a photo of the best oysters I've ever had from babasushisturbridge. The sumo oyster supreme are oysters served in half shell with citrus sauce, tobasco, black caviar and scallion. (Baba Sushi, Sturbridge)

I yam in love with this heavenly salad, so blessed that this dish carb-ed into my life. The roasted sweet potato salad from nucafe comes with sweet potato that's roasted with a dash of cinnamon/nutmeg, combined with goji berries, walnuts, and honey goat cheese served over baby spinach with a side of balsamic. If you want to be my friend, just bring me this salad...in all seriousness. (Nu Cafe, Worcester)

Experienced my first Red Sox game yesterday and it was amazing! Had to pregame with a delicious meal from mcgreevysboston. Glad I (cole) slaw the game with a happy stomach. I got the lobster roll with sides of cole slaw and sweet potato fries. Let me tell you...those were the best sweet potato fries I ever had in my life! Super crisp on the outside, but warm and fluffy potato-y on the inside. (McGreevy's, Boston)

I've been constantly sippin' some dippin'. Their coffee is currently my addiction. So many different flavors made to perfection! My favorite is cookies and cream cheesecake. (Dippin' Donuts, Worcester)
For goodness steak, this is delicious. Loving this juicy, meaty, and cheesy steak and cheese from bushelnpeck. (Bushel N Peck, Worcester)
You can Mediterranean a broken heart with this combo right here. I'm obsessed with the fresh ingredients/food that technimediterraneangrill offers. (Techni Medditeranean Grill, Worcester)

videos.caption: Feeling so marsh-mellow after this piece of work right here. I got the delicious camp fire ice cream rolls topped with strawberry, cookie crumbs, brownie pieces, teddy graham crackers, and a toasted marshmellow. It's a cold item, but it warms my heart right up. (Tastetea Rolls, Worcester)

I don't think it's pastabowl to find better lobster ravioli than this. biagio_ristorante blessed me with this homemade ravioli filled with plump Maine lobster in a sherry cream sauce and topped with perfectly cooked asparagus. Definitely the way to my heart. Btw this is my favorite Italian restaurant by far, totally worth the drive. (Biagio Ristorante, Waltham)

Happy national coffee day! I know this isn't technically a coffee...but it's something that you need to chai. Plus, I bought it from acousticjava, which is a coffee shop. This chai latte is by far my favorite cafe type of drink. (Acoustic Java, Worcester)
This cupcake was so delicious I just wanna yell-vet from the roof tops! thequeenscups made this delicious and moist. The icing was perfect and not too sweet. (Queens Cups)

This is so delicious...you better calm down or you'll artichoke. The ravioli are wrapped in spinach pasta served in sundried tomato cream sauce. The ravioli are made in-house and taste delicious, from my one of my favorite Italian restaurants biagio_ristorante. (Biagio Ristorante, Waltham)

Lettuce rejoice over this delicious traditional thai style papaya salad from bahnthai2. The papaya is diced/sliced & tossed with green beans, tomatos, carrots, chili peppers, & fish sauce & served with lettuce. This is for those who have an adventurous palette. Tastes better spicy (scale 1-5), but they can make it non-spicy. (Thai Place, Worcester)

Celebrate fry-day the 13th with these bomb parmesan fries from worcestersandwichhut. The large fry is a GIANT serving of delicious fries tossed in parmesan cheese. I love that they're tossed/lathered in parmesan cheese instead of just sprinkled at the top. Half the fries are crispy while the other half are softer (I personally love this variation). (The Sandwich Hut, Worcester)

If you do me wrong, get me food to make it rice again. Particularly, shrimp hibachi dinner with spicy fried rice. What completes this meal is the two special sauces on the side. I use the brown one for vegetables (zuchini, onion & mushrooms) & the orange-ish one for meat/rice. Though some veggies look burnt, they taste good & aren't really burnt. (Kyoto, Worcester)

On a tough day, sweets will shave your life. This mango shaved ice from doublechinbos looks pretty epic. It was a seriously large pile of shaved ice with mango syrup, mango slices, blueberries, & mochi topped with vanilla ice cream. It was too sweet for me due to the overload of mango syrup. The ice tasted better with vanilla ice cream. I was sad that there was like 5 mango pieces & 5 blueberries. (Double Chin, Boston)

Your tastebuds will go coco, nuts, & bananas for this oahu acai bowl from nucafe. It contains organic acai, bananas, fresh apple juice & almond milk topped with fresh strawberries, granola, banana, goji berries, & local honey. Beautifully presented, tasted even better. Thanks for hosting such a great yelp event for the Metrowest area. (Nu Cafe, Worcester)

I apple-y ate this apple crisp from tougasfarm while my bf screamed for the oreo ice cream (though he said it wasn't as good). I got the apple crisp with pumpkin ice cream. It was a delicious combination. Parts of the apple crisp was more on the mushy side, but I still enjoyed it. (Tougas Family Farm, Northborough)

Yum yum in my tum tum, that's what this is. Literally, its called yum yum shrimp. It contains lightly battered shrimp tossed w/ mayo flavored sweet & sour sauce. Shrimp was juicy & full of flavor. Not too heavy on the stomach either! (Paku Paku, Worcester)

We need to toast to this amazing dessert from doublechinbos. They're famous for their cube toast, & so we tried the matcha ma call it today. This cubed toast has green tea ice cream, red bean, fresh fruit (strawberries, peaches, & blueberries), pocky (strawberry & chocolate), mochi, matcha milk, & frosted flakes. It is humungous & loaded with goodness, wouldn't make any changes. (Double Chin, Boston)

You cannolli start the week right if you reward yourself with some sweets...like these special cannollis from whollycannoli. I got white rasberry (bottom), birthday cake (middle), & pumpkin (top). Their cannollis are so crispy & delicious, melts right in your mouth. The filling is super yummy, my favorite is the birthday cake flavor (love the cake crumbs). (Wholly Cannolli, Worcester)
Words can't expresso how delicious this hot carmello & red velvet cupcake are from the beancounter_bakery. Happy! (The Bean Counter)

Cheesus christ...today is a great day for a warm toasty pizza. We tried the broccoli rabe wood oven pizza from tapestryboston. It contains broccolli, pancetta, calabrian chili & garlic. I don't think it was the pizza for me though, the broccolli made the pizza quite bitter. Shame on Alex for picking the wrong pizza. However, the breading/crust was good! (Tapestry Boston)

I don't wanna spam your feed...but this is too good not to share! Please check out the spam & taro fries from doublechinbos, you won't regret it. Love their creativity & deliciousness. (Double Chin, Boston)

I don't care if you oy-stare at me...I'm going to continue to slurp these babies up. Oysters from tapestryboston tasted very fresh & clean on the tastebuds. Would've been better with more cocktail sauce, lemon, & a dash of pepper/salt...but still made me happy.

This is o-fish-ally one of my favorite items from bonchonchicken. The salmon avocado ball has a mix of avocado, crab meat, cucumber & fish roe wrapped seared fresh salmon, topped w/ spicy mayo, unagi sauce, & crunchy tempura bites. Everything combined is like putting a delicious bomb in your mouth. Please send me reccomendations to try from their menu, always looking to try something new!

Life is such a chore(izo) sometimes, but eating tacos along the way makes it better. Visited laterraza_grill yesterday for a variety of tacos! We tried the campechada, al pastor & chorizo tacos. The campechada taco has carne asada w/ mushroom & cheese. Al pastor had diced pork with grilled pineapple. The chorizo had ground pork. (La Terraza Parilla Mexicana, Worcester)

You need to roll on in yokiexpress for some rice sushi burritos. We had such a great time last night meeting other foodies & feasting, thank you for having us! Yokie offers super fresh & delicious ingredients from the local area. They have poke bowls & sushi burritos. You can either custom make yours or choose a signature. (Yokie Express, Boston)

This sandwich will clover your tastebuds with flavor. A big thank you to cloverfoodlab for welcoming us to try their famous brussel sprout sandwich & teaching us about the behind-the-scenes. It was great meeting more foodies. Did you know...Clover doesn't even own freezers! They source their ingredients carefully, making sure they are quality & delicious. (CloverFIN, Boston)

You crust try this chicken caesar salad flatbread pie from cornergrilleworcester! It is topped w/ caesar dressing, chicken, tomatoes, parmesan-mozarella cheese & cool chopped caesar salad. Could've definitely used more chicken, tomatoes, & cheese...but still tasted divine. This place has the best flatbread I have ever had in my life, my goal in life is to try all the flavors! (Corner Grille, Worcester)

You're a kung fool if you don't like bubble tea! Love kungfuteausa. We got a taro milk tea with egg pudding (my favorite topping im the world ), green milk tea w/ boba, & another taro milk tea w/ boba. The green milk tea was.com. The taro was yummy, but a little too sweet. (Kung Fu Tea, Boston)

This portuguese chicken rice from doublechinbos really (cheese) pulled my tastebuds in. This cheese pull is performed by princessgloriachinfeasts herself. This dish is made with white rice, coconut milk, tumeric cheese & chicken topped w/ some scallions. I never had cheese w/ rice before, I regret not having it sooner. (Double Chin, Boston)

Poké me, so I know this isn't just a dream. This delicious poke bowl from yokiexpress was amazing. You can custom make your own or order a signature. I got the sakura del sol which has salmon, avocado, cucumbers, purple cabbage, sliced red raddish, mixed greens, sliced jalopeno, spicy siracha mayo, sesame ginger dressing & crunch tempura flakes. (Yokie Express, Boston)

Serving me this dish could be the most ramen-tic thing you can do for me. The shin ramen stir fry from doublechinbos really hits the spot. There is just so much flavor mixed in, I also love their presentation creativity. (Double Chin, Boston)

You gotta bao down to delicious food from bonchonchicken! These are steamed wheat buns w/ slices of pork belly topped with cucumber, cole slaw & katsu sauce. The combinations are great together, but everything tasted cold & threw the whole thing off. The pork buns from the Allston location are much much better.

If you're feeling bleu (cheese), stop by thepunkandpoet to taste these babies...you'll feel 100x better. The buffalo cauliflower is amazing, I like it even more than buffalo chicken (can barely taste a difference). The cauliflower is served w/ pickled celery & whipped bleu cheese dip = PERFECTION. This dish has to be one of my faves from tonight's amazing dinner. Big thank you to thepunkandpoet. (The Punk & Poet, Boston)

Dough these warm donuts from thepunkandpoet count as breakfast?! These donuts were so crispy on the outside while super soft & moist in the inside. They're even more amazing dipped in chocolate or caramel. You can't go wrong ordering these! (The Punk & Poet, Boston)

This dish will make you tingle from your head to your toasts. In honor of a late, I'm whipping out this pumpkin cubed toast from doublechinbos. It has frosted flakes, blueberries, mango, peaches, mochi, strawberry, pocky sticks, condensed milk, chocolate syrup, delicious toast & amazing pumpkin spice latte ice cream. The ice cream & warm toast definitely has to be my favorite part. (Double Chin, Boston)

If your man doesn't spoon feed you sweet desserts, let that mango. bahnthai2 offers mango sticky rice, which is a common thai dessert that is a blessing to the tastebuds. The sticky rice has a beautiful consistency. This in combination with sweet mango pieces & coconut milk puts me in shock. (Bahn Thai, Worcester)

Sliding into the weekend with these sliders from thepunkandpoet is major key. They put fried chicken in b/w buttermilk biscuits w/ lettuce & jalopeno popper cheese. The chicken appears dry, but you are fooled my friend. The outside is pleasantly crispy while the inside is delicious & moist. The buscuits are also lightly crispy on the outside while warm & moist in the inside. (The Punk & Poet, Boston)
Happy from these crazy cookie sandwiches from whollycannoli. (Wholly Cannoli, Worcester)
They ask me what I live for, I say racks on racks on racks...of boba milk tea. I've been obsessed w/ taro & green tea milk teas from kungfuteausa lately. (Kung Fu Tea, Boston)
Don't take life for (pome)granted. Stick those fancy pinkys out & enjoy a drink, cheers to the weekend! (The Punk & Poet)

Curry into thaitimeworcester to grab some delicious dishes. The panang curry has baby corn, carrots, broccoli, green peppers & lime leaves. Ingredients & mix tasted very good, super flavorful & heartwarming! (Thai Time, Worcester)

Meatballin' so hard, the waiter tryna fine me. You need to chick out certified_meatball for a variety of delicious meatballs & dessert balls (though they got a lot more than balls)! It was so unique how their menu revolves around meatballs, I loved it. We tried the chicken fried steak balls, which has southern fried beef meatballs smothered in sausage-cream gravy. The gravy was my favorite part. (Certified Meatball Co., Boston)

Celebrate the hollandaise w/ a tasty meal from liviasdish. That's what thuwaander & I did today, & it was delish! We got the eggs benedict which consists of poached eggs rested ontop of toasted foccacia, prosciutto ham, & creamy hollandaise sauce. It was perfect on the tastebuds. The fries here are also amazing, freshly cut & perfectly seasoned. (Livia's Dish, Worcester)

I enjoyed this dish from liviasdish a waffle lot. The waffle was so fluffy & the caramelized bananas toasted w/ cinnamon pecans were perfection! Also, the powered sugar & whipped cream made it even better. (Livia's Dish, Worcester)

This delicious meal from thaitimeworcester got me tongue thai-ed. The shrimp & chicken pad thai was very flavorful. Compared to other pad thais I've had, this one is a more soy sauce flavored & less peanut flavored. I prefer my pad thai the more peanut-y way, but it was still yummy. The portions were rather generous, but price is higher than others. (Thai Time, Worcester)
I'm sorry, but this is one of my favorite rolls...so I'm not going to share. Try asking salmon else. Cream cheese & salmon wrapped in seaweed & rice...say no more. (Kyoto, Worcester)

Don't be such a selfish pesto, & share this delicious dish from certified_meatball w/ those you love. This spinach & portobello ravioli in pesto cream sauce was amazing! It was the perfect balance of flavor & texture...I need more! (Certified Meatball Co., Boston)

For goodness steak, this was delicious. towneboston served this tasty organic steak frites which has grassfed hanger steak w/ brandy au poivre. The steak was cooked perfectly & melted in your mouth. The sauce on top was a major key. And the fries were nice & crispy. Big thanks to towneboston for having us. (Towne Stove & Spirits, Boston)

Hope you all have a gret(al) holiday. Maybe you should celebrate w/ this crazy Hansel & Gretal alcoholic drink from certified_meatball. It was pretty delicious & looked cute/festive coming in this giant gingerbread house. (Certified Meatball Co., Boston)

Pick up your cavatelli-phones to call up a friend to go to caffeespressotrattoria for some fine italian cusine. I got the cavatelli alla norma b/c their cavatelli pasta are made from scratch, super delicious! I loved the sauce & ingredients (eggplant, portobello mushrooms, onions, tomatoes, cream, truffle oil, & herbs) as well. The chicken was somewhat dry & lacked flavor. (Caffe Espresso Trattoria, Worcester)

Add some pizza-z to your tastebuds w/ this delicious point lobster flatbread pizza from towneboston. It was my favorite thing from there so far. This flatbread has lobster, honey, grilled corn, & scallions. It was such a unique but super delicious combination of flavors...obsessed.

This mac & cheese is bacon me crazy in love. doublechinbos created an American/Asian fusion version: w/ wide rice noodles ("chow fun"), bacon, cheese, panko, & scallions. It was such a delicious twist, we totally enjoyed it! (Double Chin, Boston)

It would be a big misteak to skip out on a delicious meal at towneboston. The Steak Arrabiata is cooked how you want & served w/ arugula, cherry tomatoes, & cheese shavings. Love how this dish is garnered & how it doesn't make you feel bloated/full afterwards.
How bao we ring in the new year with continued good eats from certified_meatball?! We got the spicy korean pork bao w/ their teriyaki sauce. (Certified Meatball Co., Boston)

videos.caption: This dish will gnocchi your tastebuds outta this world. This is legitimately the best gnocchi I've had in my life so far. towneboston makes this spinach potato gnocchi that comes w/ roasted cherry tomatoes, parmesan cheese, & crispy fried spinach. Lemme tel ya, spinach never tasted so good.

I'm not very eggstatic that today is Monday...I would love to rewind to brunch at liviasdish yesterday when I got the Mediterranean Benedict. It has 2 poached eggs, portobello mushroom, spinach, panini bread, & hollandaise sauce served w/ homefries. It was delicious, just wished there were more mushrooms, not sure if I actually had any. (Livia's Dish, Worcester)

Honey, you must(ard) try out bushelnpeck 's delicious foods. This honey mustard wrap has sliced chicken breast, swiss cheese, honey mustard sauce, lettuce, tomato, & onions rolled in a wheat tortilla. Great combo of ingredients/flavors, would've added a lot more sauce to elevate it. Otherwise, yum yum! (Bushel N' Peck, Worcester)

These sliders pulled us right in for a good time. The pulled pork sliders at brew.city are delicious. It has in-house hickory smoked pork tossed in their own beer BBQ sauce topped w/ fresh cole slaw on butter toasted house roll. These were super tasty, I certainly have no complaints! Especially when we got it for $5 during happy hour. (Brew City, Worcester)

I don't mean to be crepey, but I see you looking all fine & delicious over there. liviasdish has this amazing crepe w/ sweet ricotta, fig jam, & honey. You need to try it for yourself. (Livia's Dish, Worcester)

I might stix around this place & try some more yummies. We tried out stixnoodlebar for the first time last week. We had the chili chicken ramen that has grilled chicken w/ Stix's signature broth finished w/ red onions, scallions, bean sprouts, bamboo shoots, & chilis w/ cilantro & lime. The broth was the perfect balance of flavor & creaminess. I really enjoyed all the ingredients & broth.

It's impastable to to resist the options at nonnasworcester that recently opened at the railers_hc 's new ice arena! Pictured here is the chicken marsala pasta. This is sauteed with mushrooms, onions, garlic, marsala brown gravy, & spaghetti. Serving size was great. I really loved all the flavor & ingredients in this dish, it was definitely well put together. (Nonna's, Worcester)

This dish from meze_greek_tapas leaves me so happy. I seriously have an obsession with eating grape leaves. These grape leaves are served with white rice & a side of delicious tzatziki sauce (my absolutely favorite ). (Meze Greek Tapas, Worcester)

This burger is fuh king genius. This creation is named "The King" after Elvis Presley who always ordered peanut butter and banana on his burgers. I thought it sounded weird...but it tastes so right. This black angus burger has bacon, grilled banana, and creamy peanut butter on a butter toasted ciabatta roll. Gotta try it for yourself. (Brew City, Worcester)

It felt eggcellent to have breakfast in bed while away on vacation. If you know me, 99% of the time, I'll order eggs benedict for breakfast. So delicious and irresistible...how could you not?! (Nantasket Beach Resort)

Alma-god this is the most ducking delicious duck dish I've ever had. We stumbled into almanove last week to find out not only do they have amazing food, but the restaurant is owned/operated by the Wahlberg family. This roasted long island duck was so tender, flavorful, and the skin was deliciously crisp. It was served with summer vegetable succotash and cherry agrodolce. (Alma Nove, Hingham)

Hope everyone has a (meat) ball this holiday weekend. Make it even better with eating lamb meatballs from almanove in Hingham. These lamb meatballs were served with corriander, mint, and citrus yogurt. Super delicious appetizer. (Alma Nove, Hingham MA)

Dont be a pest-o...I'm not sharing this deliciousness. But you can get your own chicken pesto wrap from steamenergycafe. It has sliced chicken breast, roasted red pepper, arugula, sundried tomatoes, onion, and arugula-basil pesto on a whole wheat tortilla. Super delicious, but also healthy. I love that combo because it doesn't make me feel guilty. (Steam Energy Cafe, Worcester)

This donut will Rocco your world. We tried the Reese's donut from roccodoughnutco this morning. They're pretty big donuts. The donut part was nice and fluffy. The toppings were just perfect! Definitely wanted some fruity pebble donuts, but they ran out. So maybe next time. (Rocco's Doughnut Co., Millbury)

If you hungry and you know it...clap your lamb. Check out this lamb and beef gyro from tasteofmediterranean.worcester. Alex added some veggies and the amazing tzatziki sauce of course. It was pretty delicious, I really liked the flavor and consistency of the meats! If you haven't been here, try it out. You design your own bowl, wrap, sandwich, or salad. (Taste of Mediterranean, Worcester)

This place might get your appetite railer excited! We checked out railerssportstavern the other day. Started our meal with the Railer Joe's. These are their house sausage sliders served sloppy Joe style with peppers, onions, mustard, and cheddar. Ugh came out loaded in meat/toppings...nice and warm...just perfect! We also loved the sports feel of the place, definitely a place to check out. (Railers Sports Tavern, Worcester)

Happy cinco de mayo! Taco bout a fun-filled day at the bostontacofestival today. We got this at the Thai Fusion booth. This taco has beef, papaya salad, and other vegetables on a corn tortilla. Meat was kind of tough. Also, could've used more flavor and sauciness, but ok! Pretty though! (Boston Taco Festival)

This pork dish from bullfinchs was oso good!! This is the pork oso bucco dish, which has pork served w/ sticky rice & mango chutney; topped w/ honey ginger sauce. Honestly, the meat slid off the bone, tender, & full of flavor. All the ingredients just came together so well & invited us for another bite!

Don't be a rookie...grab these cookies from cookiemonstahboston! We had the honor of trying this cookie sandwich with coconut ice cream in between. Wow, such an amazing combo. The ice cream tasted delicious along w/ the perfected cookies. I love that the cookies are dry/crumbly, but not too soft/mushy. Must try! (Cookie Monstah, Boston Taco Fest)
Taco bout a great summer shnack at thebaysiderestaurant after the beach. I ordered extra cole slaw to top it off cause fish tacos are way better with slaw! (The Bayside Restaurant, Westport)
Have yourself a ball...and check out maddis_cookery! We had the buffalo chicken balls which were DELICIOUS. The touch of apple was genius. Flavor, texture, & portion were perfect. (Maddi's Cookery)

It's so rice that it's finally the weekend!!!! Hope everyone can relax this weekend & eat a delicious meal. For example this mango chicken dish we tried from maddis_cookery! The chicken was well cooked/flavored. Loved the mango, vegetables, & black rice! (Maddi's Cookery & Tap House)

The food truck festival was a great clustertruck (in the most amazing way ever)! We enjoyed so many items: a lamb gyro wrap from Kebabish (best gyro I've ever had), Korean beef bowl from five_loaves_mobile, Mexican elote (my favorite street food) from elotiboston, & a pulled pork sandwich from saypao_usa! Everything was amazing!!!

Delicious ramen broth to you by brothramenbar. I got the creamy tomato & grilled cheese ramen; it has black garlic roasted tomato broth, grilled cheese skewer, fried garlic, shitake mushroom, & a shoyu egg. Broth brings a twist to ramen...I love tomato soup & grilled cheese so it was a no brainer. Loved it! (Broth by the Hangover, Worcester)

This de double trouble from wafflesanddinges is wafully good! Two delicious waffles were sandwiching layers of banana, strawberry, whipped cream, & nutella. The waffles had some kind of glaze over them that added a slight sweet flavor w/ almost a crispy texture. Gotta try it! (Waffles & Dinges)

Do you get eggcited over brunch too?! Cause we do. We tried the buffalo benedict from theplaywrightbar. It has 2 poached eggs on toasted stone & skillet english muffins w/ cornflake fried chicken topped w/ buffalo hollandaise. Overall it was pretty good. However, chicken didn't have much flavor & was a little dry I was expecting it to be soaked in buffalo sauce. (The Playwright Bar, Boston (Southie))
