videos.caption: My heart would be torn-ellini if peppercornsworcester Tortellini Mathew was taken away from me. This dish has sauteed chicken, spinach, cheese tortellini, & peppercorn tomato sauce. The ingredients, texture, & flavor was perfection.

Oh Maui Waui...here's my favorite take on Hawaiian pizza from dacostaspizzabakery. It has pineapple bacon jalapeno jam, black forest ham, fried rosemary, fresh mozzarella & fontina. Love their wood oven fired pizza...great quality & taste. (Dacosta's Pizza Bakery)

Donut fear...roccodoughnutco is here. Been dying to try the fruity pebbles donut but could only manage to grab an oreo donut b/c they ran out of fruity pebbles. A little too sweet & hard for me...but I'm determined to go back for the fruity pebbles one day! If you love oreos...this may very well be the donut for you. What's your favorite donut?! (Millbury, MA)

Hole-y crap...these are the best donuts I've ever had in my life!!! Had the privilege to attend cbgwoo 's first brunch today. We were in for such a treat! One of the best dishes was the mini ricotta honey donuts; which was served with sweet lemon cream & seasonal berries (raspberries). The food was quality, tasty, & all locally sourced! (City Bar & Grille, Worcester)

I can't even explain hummus I loved this dish from cbgwoo. Who knew getting hummus for brunch would be the best decision of my life. Their house made butternut squash hummus is topped with olives & feta cheese with a side of pita bread & fresh greens. Portion was quite large, ingredients tasted so fresh, & combination of it all was perfection. (City Bar & Grille, Worcester)

This dish is smokin' in taste & looks. Check out this smoked salmon avocado toast brunch dish from cbgwoo. It has tomatoes, avocado green beans, arugula, honey wheat, & a poached egg with a side of potatoes. What I love about this dish is that its relatively healthy, all ingredients are locally sourced, & you basically have all of the food groups on one beautiful dish. (City Bar & Grille)

Miso obsessed with ramen. There's just so much flavor & ingredients...plus slurping on tasty broth makes everything better on a rainy/gloomy day. We checked out ramensantoukausmawa in Cambridge. I got the spicy miso ramen which came with pork belly cuts, eggs, scallions, sesame, & so much more that I can't remember. (Hokaido Ramen Santouka, Cambridge)

You better get that booty up and goat to flyingrhinocafe to taste this baked goat cheese dish. This dish contains their housemade boursin cheese served w/ warm sweet tomato jam & grilled ciabatta bread. Literally obsessed with this dish...you'll see why once you try it. (Flying Rhino, Worcester)

Al-ban(ian) you from my life if you don't share this Albanian Fergese dish with me. This is a small plate from lock_50 which consists of peppers, tomato & feta cheese with grilled bread. Had an amazing date with my girlfriend rzzcreative, & the food left us quite impressed. (Lock 50, Worcester)

Talytas serves anything but plain(tain) dishes. We must taco bout their authentic Mexican-Salvadorean cuisine. My wife & I stopped here for authentic/cheap eats. We got an assortment of tacos (pork, shrimp, chicken, steak, etc.). My favorite was probably the pork cause it was so flavorful & crispy. Btw, they are changing their name to U Mana & changing their menu, so look out. (Talyta's, Worcester)
This matcha crunch from sweetwafflesandboba was waffully delicious. Who doesnt love a warm fluffy waffle drizzled with matcha, pistachios, & powdered sugar on a stick. (Sweet Boba + Waffles)

smokestackurbanbbq is so porkin' good. This pulled pork sandwich with slaw & sauce between buns was bomb. The meat was so tender and tasty, & all the flavors complimented eachother beautifully. Definitely recomend, & will be coming back. (BT'S Smokehouse)

videos.caption: I'm o-fish-ally obsessed with this salmon from oishiiboston which was lit...literally on fire. The salmon started fresh & had eloquent flavor. The salmon was garnished with fried shallots & a side of raspberry gastrique. Definitely recommend!

We all need to meat at oishiiboston cause this dish was drippin' in (s)wag-yu & will stone your tastebuds silly. This is the Wagyu beef ishiyaki where you cook the meat on a hot stone, let it sizzle for 7-8 seconds on each side for a medium rare flare. The meat was so well flavored & tender...& melted in my mouth. So...I'm basically obsessed.

Let's toast to a beautiful new week!l with this ricotta & honey toast from fuelamerica. I got a wheat toast e/ ricotta, honey, mint, & sunflower seeds. The combo was a refreshing light snack, definitely recommend. (Fuel America, Worcester)
I know quarantine can get ravi-lonely....but I've been successfully filling that void with fire foods (Napoli, Shrewsbury)
These times may be bakin' you crazy...but something sweet from gerardositalianbakery might take the edge off a bit. (Gerardo's, Shrewsbury)

The flavor in this sandwich is no porkin' joke, it just pulls together so well. Can't wait to go out to eat three times a day, seven days a week when this is over. smokestackurbanbbq (Smokstack, Worcester)

Cheeses christ, I'm gonna be jalopeno business if you eating one of sandwiches in front of me. I'd probably fight you for it because there's so much delicious goodness at steak. This steak & cheese bomb comes with steak, jalopeno, onions, & peppers. Best steak & cheese I've ever eaten. (New England Roast Beef, Worcester)
Oh lemme (ox) tail you how fire this Jamaican meal was from Flames in Providence. The meat was tender & soaked with flavor. My favorite part has to the be ox tail sauce, love my stuff SAUCY.

tastetearolls makes the most koala-ty ice cream rolls. How much better can ice cream get while it's made fresh in front of you. I ordered the birthday cake flavor & added fruity pebbles, a toasted marshmallow, mochi, & whipped cream. The texture is sooooo perfect. (Tastetea Rolls)
Lettuce rejoice over lobster rolls, & mayo tastebuds be blessed by ronniesseafoodandicecream. (Ronnie's Seafood, Auburn)

Cheesus, this dish was so(ju) good. Checked out sojubaboston after kayaking in the thunderstorm yesterday. This is the seafood ddok bokghi also called tteok-bokki, a classic Korean dish containing stir fried rice cake in delicious sauce. The seafood version had mussels, shrimp, squid, & an assortment of vegetables. Of course we added cheese.

Lettuce taco bout how delicious this appetizer from devlins02135. We got the lobster nachos which had queso, beans, corn, lettuce, tomatoes, salsa, sour cream, & guac topped with lobster. Btw, the setting was soooo beautiful: lights in the ally, storage unit bar, etc. Loved the vibe (Devlin's Restaurant)
Do-nut fear, roccodoughnutco is here to Rocco your world. (Rocco's Doughnut Company, Millbury)

This might sound cheesy, but this cold app from piattini_wine_cafe had me happy from my head to-ma-toes. This dish really just cured me(at). This is the Burrata Piattini that comes w/ heirloom tomatoes, fig balsamic, prosciutto, cilantro vinegarette, & burrata cheese. It was so refreshing & delicious, definitely want this again. (Piattini Wine Cafe, Boston)

Miso full after eating this porkin' delicious ramen. Got the spicy miso ramen that comes with chashu pork, ajitama egg, bean sprouts, sweet corn, mayu, scallions, & nori.
